input.productDescription: Overview screen of a personal budgeting app for people with irregular income, such as freelancers. It shows this month's budget against spending by category, upcoming bills, progress toward savings goals, and recent transactions. People open it several times a week to check whether they are on track. Income varies month to month, so the screen has to answer 'am I on track?' quickly and without shaming the user.
audience: freelancers and independent contractors with variable monthly income
self-employed creatives and consultants who check their finances several times a week
primaryTasks: check whether this month's spending is on track against budget
see which categories are over or under
see which bills are due next and whether they are covered
scan recent transactions for anything unexpected
avoid: generic fintech purple gradients and neon dark-mode dashboards
SaaS hero template with centered headline and CTA stack
decorative chart junk that hides the numbers
constraints: Vite + React + plain CSS only, no UI kits or Tailwind
single responsive page for phones and desktops
no external image URLs, no stock photos
numbers must be tabular and highly scannable
status must never be communicated by color alone
